name: Disarm Partner [Combat, Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
When your ally fails to disarm an opponent within your reach, you can try to disarm that same foe.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When an ally fails a disarm combat maneuver check made on his turn against an opponent within your melee reach, as an immediate action you can attempt a disarm combat maneuver check against that foe.
